name: Centro / Rossio
description: The central district around the main canal, Rossio and Praca da Republica. Art Nouveau facades, moliceiro boats, cafes and restaurants line the waterways, putting shops, the train station and daily life within a short flat walk.
bestFor: First-timers wanting canals, cafes and everything walkable in the center

name: Beira-Mar
tagline: Old fishing quarter by the canal
description: The traditional fishermen quarter along the central canal, known for its lively restaurants, tiled houses and evening buzz. It sits just north of the center and is the go-to area for seafood, bars and canal-side dining.
bestFor: Visitors wanting nightlife, seafood and canal-side character near the center

name: Gloria / University Area
description: The area around the University of Aveiro southeast of the center, with modern buildings, student housing and green riverside space. Rents are more reasonable and it offers a younger, calmer vibe within walking or cycling distance of downtown.
bestFor: Longer stays and budget nomads wanting cheaper rent near the university

name: Costa Nova / Praia da Barra
description: The coastal strip west of the city with the iconic candy-striped houses, wide Atlantic beaches and a lighthouse. A short drive or bus from Aveiro, it suits stays focused on surfing, beach walks and seaside sunsets.
bestFor: Beach lovers and surfers wanting Atlantic coast over city center
